title: The Godfather Part III
about: An ageing Michael Corleone tries to buy his way into legitimacy through the Vatican.
cue: Serve the cannoli when Michael is made a papal knight at the cathedral.
faces: The boxes on a gala night, carnations on the rail.
Melodramma in un atto di Pietro Mascagni
Turiddu: Anthony Vito Corleone, in his debut
Tonight the house welcomes his father home to Sicily.
Chickpea fritters with parsley, fried crisp. Salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Ripe cantaloupe, cured ham, cracked pepper and olive oil.
Lemon liqueur on ice, prosecco and soda, lemon peel and mint.
CON IL CONTRIBUTO DELLA FONDAZIONE VITO CORLEONE
Supper after the opera. Una sera in Sicilia.
Gala night. The Corleone party arrives.
Papa, you came back to Sicily to hear me sing. Tonight Turiddu is for you. Stay for supper after, Mamma has promised she will.
Rigatoni, fried eggplant, tomato and basil, under grated ricotta salata.
Fresh sardines, wild fennel, raisins, pine nuts and toasted crumbs.
Crisp shells filled to order with sweet ricotta, candied orange, pistachio.
Sponge, sweet ricotta and green marzipan, crowned with candied fruit.
Dry, amber and cool. Raise it to the new Commendatore.
Short and black, from the bar in the Ridotto.
Prices subject to change. Orange juice is kept at the bar for any guest who feels faint.
Programma n. 1990. Piazza Verdi, Palermo. Cannoli may be sent up to your palco.

Salt and a squeeze of lemon.Served in the foyer before curtain.How to make it250g chickpea flour750ml cold water1 tsp salt2 tbsp chopped parsley500ml neutral oil, for frying2 lemons, cut in wedgesflaky salt, to tasteWhisk the chickpea flour into the cold water with the salt until smooth.Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until very thick.Stir in the parsley and spread 1cm thick on an oiled tray. Leave to set for 1 hour.Cut into squares and fry in 180°C oil in batches until puffed and golden.Drain, season with the flaky salt and serve with lemon wedges.Prosciutto e meloneRipe cantaloupe, cured ham, cracked pepper and olive oil.Something light before the overture.How to make it1 rockmelon150g prosciutto1 tbsp extra virgin olive oilcracked black pepper, to tasteLeave the rockmelon at room temperature for an hour.Halve, deseed, cut into 12 long wedges and cut off the skin.Drape each wedge with prosciutto, add pepper and a drizzle of olive oil just before serving.MainsPasta alla NormaRigatoni, fried eggplant, tomato and basil, under grated ricotta salata.Atto unico: the supper in the Ridotto.How to make it2 eggplants120ml olive oil3 garlic cloves, sliced800g San Marzano tomatoes, tinned1 handful basil500g rigatoni100g ricotta salatasalt, to tasteCut the eggplants into thick half moons and fry in batches in most of the olive oil until deep gold. Drain.Fry the garlic in 2 tbsp of oil, add the tomatoes and basil, simmer and season.Cook the rigatoni until al dente.Toss the pasta with the sauce, eggplant and a splash of pasta water. Grate ricotta salata heavily over the top.SweetsCannoliCrisp shells filled to order with sweet ricotta, candied orange, pistachio.Boxed with care, sent up to your palco.How to make it500g fresh ricotta80g icing sugar, plus extra for dusting1/2 tsp ground cinnamon40g candied orange peel, finely chopped8 cannoli shells30g pistachios, choppedDrain the ricotta in a sieve for 2 hours.Beat with icing sugar, cinnamon and candied peel.Pipe into the shells just before serving.Dip each end in pistachios and dust with icing sugar.DrinksLimoncello e spumanteLemon liqueur on ice, prosecco and soda, lemon peel and mint.Poured in the foyer before Cavalleria rusticana.How to make it160ml limoncello360ml prosecco, chilled120ml soda water1 lemon4 sprigs of mint1 bag iceFill four large wine glasses with ice.Pour limoncello into each, top with prosecco and soda and stir once gently.Peel a wide strip of lemon zest per glass, twist over the drink and drop in. Finish with mint.
